images.caption: Part of a set of newly carved gargoyle figures created as part of the currently ongoing major restoration of the east facade of York Minster. These humourous sculptures were created by masons from the Minster's stoneyard and are new designs intended to replace worn out elements high on the external face of the cathedral. They were displayed at ground level in the south east chapel of the Minster.
images.alt: Part of a set of newly carved gargoyle figures created as part of the currently ongoing major restoration of the east facade of York Minster. These humourous sculptures were created by masons from the Minster's stoneyard and are new designs intended to replace worn out elements high on the external face of the cathedral. They were displayed at ground level in the south east chapel of the Minster.
